content: MK says Ṣāʾin al-Dīn's tribulations came about through the ease with which establishment enemies could tar him with the Hurufi brush, though his lettrism is patently intellectual and confessionally mainstream; Shāhrukh “appears to have been more than happy to let this false association stand”, and in 830/1427 used the possibly staged attempt by Aḥmad-i Lur as pretext to imprison, torture and exile him and to expel other prominent men with claimed Hurufi sympathies.
